statement: Over Q[x], expand (x+1)^2. Return JSON {"coefficients":[c0,c1,c2]} in ascending powers; coefficients are integers or rational strings.
Over Q[x], expand (2*x-3)*(x+4). Return JSON {"coefficients":[c0,c1,c2]} in ascending powers; coefficients are integers or rational strings.
Find P in Q[x] with P(0)=0 and P'(x)=3*x^2+2*x+1. Return JSON {"coefficients":[c0,c1,...]} in ascending powers; use integers or rational strings.
Find P in Q[x] with P(0)=0 and P'(x)=x^3-x. Return JSON {"coefficients":[c0,c1,...]} in ascending powers; use integers or rational strings.
Find integers a,b such that 240*a+46*b=2. Return JSON {"a":integer,"b":integer}.
